# Gammaterial

**Gammaterial** is a 固體（逐格鑽探） ore. Each extraction yields **150** units, and the zone holds it in finite **deposits (nodes)** — when a node is mined below its threshold it is removed and the zone regenerates nodes up to its configured maximum. Extracting this ore requires the matching enabler effect to be active on the robot. How the node-generation columns below are used by the server is in [Ore fields](/zh-TW/formats/ore-fields/).

## 開採

| 屬性 | 數值 |
|---|---|
| 單次開採量 | 150 |
| 開採方式 | 固體（逐格鑽探） |
| 觸發效果 | 需要 |
